data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Northern Fronts Shake as Mooring County Breached and Islands Reel
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Fighting has erupted with renewed fury across the northern theater, where Stlican Shelf reversed its earlier lull to suffer five base upheavals in two hours, ending in a seven-to-one Warden alignment with one redoubt reduced to no-man's-land. To the west, the long-standing stalemate in Mooring County finally shattered as Colonial forces seized ground around Wiccwalk amidst fourteen hundred casualties in two hours, reducing Warden control to ten bastions. In the Weathered Expanse, the meat grinder around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest accelerated violently, tallying eleven base exchanges in two hours and claiming over thirty-two hundred dead. The island combat across Fisherman's Row rages unabated, generating eight further base shifts over the same interval and stranding two strongpoints in neutral ruins across Eidolo and Arcadia. Conversely, Callahan's Passage has quieted as Wardens restored their ten-base monopoly following the recapture of Crumbling Post, while Farranac Coast also saw frontline events subside after midday skirmishes. Further east, Viper Pit recorded a steep surge in casualties without base transitions, as southern fronts remain thoroughly dormant.
